name: Your Brand
claims_allowed: only facts you can prove, e.g. 'cash on delivery'
note: Copy this folder to brands/<your-brand>/ and fill it in. Anything you cannot prove stays out of claims_allowed.

tts.style_default: A confident, warm presenter in their early 30s, mid-low pitch, medium-fast pace, clear articulation, native speaker of the brand language

alternates.gemini_free: same voice through GEMINI_API_KEY (Google free tier, about 10 requests per day per model)

tts.note: Pick the voice by ear on the same script; one request per video (one take, cut into lines). Normalize to -16 LUFS, peak at or below -1 dBFS.
